title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,451–3,500 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 內容創作者；自媒體創作者；創造者

examples.en: Digital content creators build loyal global followings through storytelling.
examples.zh: 數位自媒體內容創作者透過富有溫度的故事分享，吸引了全球無數鐵粉追隨。

examples.en: She quit her corporate job to become a full-time video creator on YouTube.
examples.zh: 她辭去了公司的正職工作，成為全職的 YouTube 影片創作者。

examples.en: The platform introduced new features to help creators connect with their audience.
examples.zh: 該平台推出了新功能，以幫助創作者更緊密地與受眾建立連結。

words.definition: 播客節目；錄製播客

examples.en: Millions of commuters listen to weekly business and comedy podcasts on trains.
examples.zh: 數百萬上班族通勤族習慣在捷運火車上收聽每週更新的商業與幽默脫口秀播客節目。

examples.en: He hosts a popular podcast where he interviews leading technology entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 他主持了一個熱門播客節目，在節目中專訪頂尖的科技創業家。

examples.en: I downloaded several podcast episodes to listen to during the long flight.
examples.zh: 我下載了幾集播客節目，準備在長途飛行途中收聽。

words.definition: 單集節目；一集；插曲

examples.en: Today's special podcast episode features an in-depth interview with a startup CEO.
examples.zh: 今天上架的特別節目單集邀請到了新創科技執行長進行一對一的深度專訪。

examples.en: Have you watched the season finale episode of that thrilling detective drama?
examples.zh: 你看過那部緊張刺激的懸疑偵探劇的本季完結篇了嗎？

examples.en: They record two new podcast episodes every weekend in their home studio.
examples.zh: 他們每個週末都會在自家的工作室裡錄製兩集新的播客節目。

words.definition: 共同主持人；搭檔主持

examples.en: The two co-hosts share great comedic chemistry and banter effortlessly.
examples.zh: 兩位搭檔共同主持人默契十足、火花四射，在節目中幽默風趣的互虧吐槽笑料不斷。

examples.en: She invited a guest expert to co-host the weekly financial news discussion.
examples.zh: 她邀請了一位客座專家一同搭檔主持每週的財經新聞座談。

examples.en: My co-host was feeling unwell, so I had to host the radio show by myself.
examples.zh: 我的搭檔主持人身體不適，所以我只好獨自一人主持這檔廣播節目。

words.definition: 電容式麥克風；專業收音麥克風

examples.en: Studio-grade condenser mics capture crisp, warm, and broadcast-ready vocals.
examples.zh: 專業錄音室等級的電容式麥克風能精準捕捉清晰通透、溫暖醇厚的主播人聲。

examples.en: A condenser mic is extremely sensitive and requires a quiet recording space.
examples.zh: 電容式麥克風極為靈敏，因此需要安靜無雜音的錄音空間。

examples.en: He invested in a quality condenser mic to significantly improve his voiceover clarity.
examples.zh: 他投資買了一支高品質電容麥克風，大幅提升了配音旁白的清晰度。

words.definition: 防噴罩；防噴麥濾網

examples.en: Attach a mesh pop filter to prevent harsh popping noises on 'P' and 'B' sounds.
examples.zh: 在麥克風前安裝雙層防噴罩濾網能有效消除發「P」與「B」爆破音時惱人的噴麥聲。

examples.en: The pop filter is positioned about two inches away from the condenser microphone.
examples.zh: 防噴罩安裝在距離電容麥克風大約兩英吋的位置。

examples.en: Without a pop filter, your vocal recordings may contain distracting bursts of air.
examples.zh: 若沒有使用防噴罩，錄製的人聲可能會夾雜令人分心的氣流爆破音。

words.definition: 錄音介面；音效卡；使用者介面

examples.en: Plug professional XLR microphones into a multi-channel USB audio interface.
examples.zh: 將專業 XLR 錄音麥克風直接接入多軌 USB 錄音介面以確保最佳無損音質。

examples.en: The software features an intuitive user interface that is easy for beginners to navigate.
examples.zh: 這款軟體擁有直覺好用的人機介面，初學者也能輕鬆上手操作。

examples.en: You need an audio interface to convert analog sound signals into digital data.
examples.zh: 你需要一台錄音介面，將類比聲音訊號轉換為電腦可識別的數位音訊資料。

words.definition: 降噪；消除；減少

examples.en: AI noise reduction software eliminates background air conditioner hum flawlessly.
examples.zh: 結合 AI 演算法的智慧降噪處理軟體能將背景中惱人的冷氣運轉低頻嗡嗡聲完美消除。

examples.en: The store announced a 30% price reduction on all consumer electronics this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店家宣布本週末全館消費性電子產品全面降價三成優惠。

examples.en: A significant reduction in carbon emissions is essential to fighting climate change.
examples.zh: 大幅減少碳排放量對於對抗全球氣候變遷至關重要。

words.definition: 背景音樂 (Background Music)

examples.en: Uplifting acoustic guitar BGM enhances the emotional mood of the travel vlog.
examples.zh: 輕快悠揚的純木吉他背景音樂（BGM）為這支旅遊 Vlog 增添了無比療癒的溫馨氛圍。

examples.en: Make sure the volume of the BGM is low enough so it doesn't drown out the speech.
examples.zh: 請務必確認背景音樂音量適中，避免蓋過講者的講話人聲。

examples.en: She spent hours choosing the perfect BGM to match the lively pace of the video.
examples.zh: 她花了數個小時挑選最合適的背景音樂，以契合影片輕快的剪輯節奏。

words.definition: RSS 節目訂閱源

examples.en: Podcasters publish an RSS feed to distribute episodes to Apple and Spotify.
examples.zh: 播客主持人設定好 RSS 節目源，即可將最新單集同步分發至各大主流串流平台。

examples.en: Submit your podcast's RSS feed to directories so listeners can find your show.
examples.zh: 將你的播客節目 RSS 來源提交至各大目錄，聽眾就能搜尋並訂閱你的節目。

examples.en: Whenever you publish a new episode, the RSS feed updates your subscribers automatically.
examples.zh: 每當你發布新單集時，RSS 訂閱源都會自動同步更新給所有訂閱者。

words.definition: 網路直播；實況開台；進行直播

examples.en: The gaming streamer attracted twenty thousand concurrent viewers on his livestream.
examples.zh: 這位人氣遊戲實況主在今晚的實況直播中吸引了超過兩萬名粉絲同時在線觀看。

examples.en: She scheduled a special livestream for Friday night to answer fan questions directly.
examples.zh: 她排定了週五晚上的特別直播，準備親自即時回答粉絲的各種提問。

examples.en: Many musicians performed via livestreams during the pandemic lockdowns.
examples.zh: 許多音樂家在疫情封城期間紛紛透過網路直播舉辦線上音樂會。

words.definition: 視訊鏡頭；網路攝影機

examples.en: High-definition 4K webcams with autofocus ensure razor-sharp video quality.
examples.zh: 配備自動對焦功能的 4K 超高畫質視訊鏡頭能確保直播主在螢幕前隨時展現清晰畫質。

examples.en: She covered her laptop webcam with a sliding sticker for extra privacy protection.
examples.zh: 她用滑蓋貼紙遮住了筆電的視訊鏡頭，以加強保護個人隱私。

examples.en: Make sure your webcam is positioned at eye level for professional video meetings.
examples.zh: 進行專業視訊會議時，請確認視訊鏡頭架設在與視線水平等高的高度。

words.definition: 直播視窗圖層；框體版面

examples.en: Customize your dynamic stream overlay with subscriber alerts and chat boxes.
examples.zh: 精心設計專屬的動態直播圖層框體，整合即時訂閱跳通知特效與側欄聊天室。

examples.en: The graphic artist created an animated overlay with transparent borders for Twitch streamers.
examples.zh: 視覺設計師為 Twitch 實況主打造了帶有半透明邊框的精美動態視窗圖層。

examples.en: A cluttered stream overlay can block important game details on screen.
examples.zh: 過於雜亂擁擠的直播圖層可能會遮擋住螢幕畫面上重要的遊戲細節。

words.definition: 綠幕去背；色鍵去背扣像

examples.en: Chroma key compositing removes the studio green screen background in real time.
examples.zh: 透過先進的即時色鍵綠幕去背扣像技術，能將實況主身後的綠幕完美替換為遊戲場景。

examples.en: Film studios use chroma key effects to place actors into magical fantasy worlds.
examples.zh: 電影製片廠運用色鍵去背特效，將演員無縫置入奇幻的魔法世界之中。

examples.en: Proper studio lighting is crucial to achieve a clean chroma key without green spill.
examples.zh: 專業均勻的棚內燈光是取得乾淨綠幕去背且不產生綠邊溢色的關鍵。

words.definition: 超級留言；付費置頂打賞 (Super Chat)

examples.en: Loyal fans send generous super chats to highlight their questions on screen.
examples.zh: 熱情忠實的鐵粉紛紛發送醒目的付費置頂超級留言（Super Chat）以向實況主提問。

examples.en: The YouTuber expressed sincere gratitude whenever a viewer sent a big super chat.
examples.zh: 每當有觀眾發送大額超級留言時，該 YouTuber 都會表達誠摯的感謝。

examples.en: Sending a colorful super chat guarantees your message will stay pinned on the chat feed.
examples.zh: 發送色彩鮮豔的付費留言能確保你的訊息在聊天室訊息流中維持置頂高亮。

words.definition: 打賞贊助；抖內；小費；實用秘訣

examples.en: Viewers can tip their favorite indie musicians directly via the virtual tip jar.
examples.zh: 觀看線上演出的熱情粉絲可透過虛擬小費箱直接線上打賞抖內支持獨立創作歌手。

examples.en: In many countries, it is customary to tip restaurant waiters between 15% and 20%.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，用餐後給餐廳服務生 15% 至 20% 的小費是一項慣例。

examples.en: The experienced photographer gave us a helpful tip on shooting in low light.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的攝影師給了我們一個在微光環境下拍攝的實用技巧秘訣。

words.definition: 聊天室管理員 (Mod / 房管)；公道人

examples.en: Chat moderators keep the livestream chat friendly by removing spam and trolls.
examples.zh: 盡職的聊天室管理員（房管）隨時巡邏，及時清理洗版廣告並維持良好的互動氛圍。

examples.en: The panel discussion featured a knowledgeable moderator who guided the conversation well.
examples.zh: 該場座談會由一位博學的主持引言人引導，讓對談進行得十分流暢且深入。

examples.en: She was promoted to senior moderator after volunteering on the community forum for two years.
examples.zh: 她在社群論壇擔任志工兩年後，被拔擢為資深討論區管理員。

words.definition: 封鎖；禁止發言；禁令

examples.en: The channel automated bot banned toxic users who violated community rules.
examples.zh: 頻道智慧管理機器人會自動對惡意違規侮辱他人的酸民帳號祭出永久封鎖禁言。

examples.en: The government placed a total ban on the sale of single-use plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府全面實施了禁止販售一次性塑膠提袋的法令禁令。

examples.en: He received a temporary chat ban for posting repetitive advertisements.
examples.zh: 他因為在聊天室中重複張貼廣告連結，而遭到了暫時禁言的懲罰。

words.definition: 影片縮圖；預覽小圖

examples.en: A high-contrast, expressive thumbnail dramatically boosts click-through rates.
examples.zh: 一張構圖鮮明吸睛、表情生動張力十足的客製化影片縮圖能大幅拉升點閱率。

examples.en: Designers often test different thumbnail designs to see which one attracts more viewers.
examples.zh: 設計師通常會測試不同的縮圖樣式，看看哪一種設計更能吸引觀眾點擊。

examples.en: Don't use misleading thumbnails that promise content you don't actually deliver.
examples.zh: 千萬不要使用名不符實的標題黨欺騙性縮圖，以免辜負了觀眾的信任。

words.definition: 點閱率；點擊轉化率 (Click-Through Rate)

examples.en: Optimizing the video title and cover boosted average CTR from 4% to 9%.
examples.zh: 重新微調優化影片標題與吸睛封面縮圖後，成功將平均點閱率（CTR）由 4% 推升至 9%。

examples.en: Digital marketers track CTR closely to measure how effectively ads attract clicks.
examples.zh: 數位行銷人員密切追蹤點閱率，藉此評估廣告吸引點擊的成效好壞。

examples.en: An engaging subject line can significantly increase your email campaign CTR.
examples.zh: 吸引人的電子郵件主旨能顯著提高行銷信件的點閱率與轉換率。

words.definition: 吸睛開場；開頭鉤子；魚鉤

examples.en: Craft a compelling 5-second video hook to retain viewer attention instantly.
examples.zh: 精心打磨影片開頭前五秒最具懸念的吸睛開場鉤子，能牢牢抓住觀眾的眼球不滑走。

examples.en: The opening scene of the mystery novel served as an irresistible storytelling hook.
examples.zh: 這部懸疑小說的開場場景成了一個讓人欲罷不能的引人入勝開頭懸念。

examples.en: The song has a catchy musical hook that sticks in your head all day long.
examples.zh: 這首歌有一段極為洗腦的旋律副歌記憶點，讓人整天都在腦海中縈繞。

words.definition: 觀眾續看留存率；記憶力

examples.en: Fast-paced editing and dynamic B-roll maintain high audience retention.
examples.zh: 明快的剪輯節奏搭配豐富多變的輔助畫面（B-roll）能全程維持極高的觀眾續看留存率。

examples.en: The company introduced better staff benefits to improve employee retention rates.
examples.zh: 公司推出了更優渥的員工福利，以提高優秀人才的員工留任率。

examples.en: Good study habits promote long-term retention of complex academic material.
examples.zh: 良好的讀書習慣有助於長久記憶與牢固掌握複雜的學術知識。

words.definition: 行動呼籲 (Call To Action；如按讚訂閱)

examples.en: End every educational short with a clear CTA urging viewers to leave thoughts.
examples.zh: 在每支知識型短影音片尾皆加上清晰明確的行動呼籲（CTA），引導粉絲在底下留言。

examples.en: A well-designed website should place its primary CTA button above the fold.
examples.zh: 設計精良的網頁應該將最關鍵的行動呼籲按鈕置於首屏醒目位置。

examples.en: His video concluded with a friendly CTA reminding viewers to like and subscribe.
examples.zh: 他的影片結尾附上親切的行動呼籲，提醒觀眾順手按讚並訂閱頻道。

words.definition: 粉絲追蹤者；追隨者

examples.en: The food vlogger gained over one hundred thousand followers within a single year.
examples.zh: 這位專門挖掘隱藏版夜市小吃的美食創作者在短短一年內便斬獲逾十萬名死忠追隨者。

examples.en: Celebrities often communicate with their followers through casual social media stories.
examples.zh: 知名名人經常透過隨性的社群限時動態直接與廣大粉絲互動交流。

examples.en: He is a loyal follower of modern minimalist design and eco-friendly lifestyles.
examples.zh: 他是現代極簡主義設計與綠色環保生活方式的堅定追隨者。

words.definition: 頻道付費會員資格；會籍

examples.en: Channel memberships offer exclusive behind-the-scenes vlogs and custom emojis.
examples.zh: 加入頻道每月付費專屬會員即可享有搶先收看未公開幕後花絮與專屬徽章貼圖特權。

examples.en: She renewed her annual gym membership to stay committed to fitness goals.
examples.zh: 她續訂了一年的健身房會員會籍，以督促自己達成健康體態的目標。

examples.en: Library membership allows you to borrow up to ten books and audiobooks at a time.
examples.zh: 辦理圖書館借閱證會員資格後，你一次最多可借閱十本書籍或有聲書。

words.definition: 流量變現；商業獲利機制

examples.en: Creators explore diversified monetization, including brand deals and online courses.
examples.zh: 頂尖創作者積極拓展多元化的流量變現模式，涵蓋品牌跨界代言與線上付費課程。

examples.en: Successful monetization of free mobile apps often relies on in-app purchases and ads.
examples.zh: 免費手機應用程式若要成功變現獲利，通常仰賴應用程式內購與廣告置入。

examples.en: Content platforms set strict criteria before enabling channel monetization features.
examples.zh: 影音內容平台在為頻道開通商業變現獲利功能之前，會設定嚴格的審查門檻。

words.definition: 廣告營收收益；稅收

examples.en: AdSense advertising revenue fluctuates based on seasonal marketing budgets.
examples.zh: YouTube 平台所分潤發放的 AdSense 廣告收益會隨著各大企業每季的行銷預算而波動。

examples.en: The tech firm reported record quarterly revenue thanks to booming cloud computing sales.
examples.zh: 拜雲端運算業務蓬勃成長所賜，這家科技大廠公布了創紀錄的單季營收。

examples.en: Governments depend on tax revenue to fund public education and infrastructure projects.
examples.zh: 政府高度仰賴各項稅收收入，以支應公共教育與重大基礎建設工程的龐大開銷。

words.definition: 品牌贊助；商業代言合作

examples.en: The gaming tournament secured major sponsorship from top PC hardware brands.
examples.zh: 這場電競嘉年華大賽成功爭取到了眾多一線頂級電競硬體大廠的千萬級品牌商業贊助。

examples.en: Brand sponsorship allows podcasters to produce higher-quality audio content.
examples.zh: 企業品牌的商業贊助使播客創作者能夠有充裕資金產出更優質的聲音內容。

examples.en: The cultural festival was made possible through corporate sponsorships and civic grants.
examples.zh: 這場大型文化藝術節得益於各大企業的熱情贊助與市府文化補助金才得以順利舉辦。

words.definition: 置入性行銷；放置配置

examples.en: Subtle product placement in popular television series drives instant consumer sales.
examples.zh: 在熱門偶像劇中巧妙不著痕跡的品牌置入性行銷往往能在短時間內帶動驚人的爆款買氣。

examples.en: The university offers a student career placement service to help graduates find jobs.
examples.zh: 這所大學設有完善的學生就業輔導與實習媒合服務，協助畢業生順利進入職場。

examples.en: Strategic placement of emergency exit signs is required by municipal building codes.
examples.zh: 根據地方建築消防法規，緊急逃生指示標誌的安裝配置位置必須經過嚴格規範。

words.definition: 開箱影片；拆箱評測

examples.en: Tech enthusiasts love watching detailed smartphone unboxing and benchmark tests.
examples.zh: 廣大 3C 科技發燒友最愛觀看各大科技達人針對旗艦新機所拍攝的詳盡實機開箱評測。

examples.en: Her unboxing video revealed the luxury packaging and sleek accessories inside.
examples.zh: 她的實機拆箱影片完整展示了精緻奢華的包裝盒以及裡面附贈的精美配件。

examples.en: Unboxing toys has become a surprisingly popular genre among younger YouTube audiences.
examples.zh: 拆開玩具的開箱影片在 YouTube 年輕受眾族群中已經成為一門極受歡迎的熱門題材。

words.definition: 分潤行銷的；聯盟行銷；附屬機構

examples.en: Put your unique affiliate link in the video description box to earn commissions.
examples.zh: 將您的專屬分潤推薦導購連結放置於影片下方資訊欄中，即可賺取推薦抽成獎金。

examples.en: Many travel bloggers earn passive income through hotel and flight affiliate marketing programs.
examples.zh: 許多旅遊部落客透過加入飯店與機票的分潤聯盟行銷計畫來賺取穩定的被動收入。

examples.en: The local clinic is an affiliate of the prestigious national medical university hospital.
examples.zh: 這家地方綜合診所是國內頂尖國家級醫學大學附設醫院的加盟合作機構。

words.definition: 官方周邊商品；周邊小物 (Merch)

examples.en: The YouTuber launched a limited line of embroidered hoodies and official merchandise.
examples.zh: 該百萬 YouTuber 隆重推出了限量版親自設計的厚磅刺繡帽 T 等官方周邊商品。

examples.en: Concert attendees queued for hours to purchase band merchandise like posters and caps.
examples.zh: 參加演唱會的粉絲大排長龍數小時，只為搶購海報與潮流棒球帽等樂團官方周邊小物。

examples.en: Retailers must display seasonal merchandise neatly on shelves to entice customers.
examples.zh: 零售店家必須將當季熱門商品整齊陳列於貨架上，以吸引進店顧客駐足挑選。

words.definition: 群眾募資；群眾集資

examples.en: Independent board game designers successfully launched their game via crowdfunding.
examples.zh: 獨立桌遊研發團隊透過在群眾募資平台發起預購專案，成功募集了首批全額量產資金。

examples.en: Crowdfunding empowers creative inventors to raise initial production funds directly from public backers.
examples.zh: 群眾集資平台讓富有創意的發明家能直接向大眾支持者募集產品初期的量產資金。

examples.en: Their environmental documentary campaign reached its crowdfunding goal within just forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 他們的環保紀錄片募款專案在短短四十八小時之內便順利達成了預設的群募目標金額。

words.definition: 社群互動率；訂婚；約定

examples.en: Replying to community comments boosts social media algorithmic engagement scores.
examples.zh: 創作者親自逐一回覆粉絲留言互動能顯著拉升演算法對該篇貼文的社群互動率評分。

examples.en: The young couple happily celebrated their romantic engagement with close family and friends.
examples.zh: 這對年輕新人與摯愛親友聚在一塊，溫馨熱鬧地慶祝他們浪漫的訂婚喜訊。

examples.en: Teachers look for interactive lesson plans that stimulate active student engagement in class.
examples.zh: 教師們積極尋求具互動性的教學教案，以激發學生在課堂上的主動參與度與學習興致。

words.definition: 爆紅瘋傳的；病毒式的

examples.en: A witty 15-second cat comedy clip went viral across TikTok overnight.
examples.zh: 一支短短十五秒、笑點十足的搞笑貓咪短片在一夜之間於 TikTok 掀起全球瘋傳狂潮。

examples.en: The marketing team designed a viral social media campaign to promote the product launch.
examples.zh: 行銷企劃團隊精心策劃了一場病毒式社群傳播行銷戰役，為新品上市強力造勢。

examples.en: Doctors confirmed that her persistent fever and cough were caused by a mild viral infection.
examples.zh: 醫生確認她持續不斷的發燒與咳嗽症狀是由輕微的病毒感染所引起的。

words.definition: 推薦；演算法推薦機制

examples.en: Getting featured on the YouTube homepage recommendation tab explodes video views.
examples.zh: 影片若能成功被推薦演算法選中並推播至首頁探索推薦版位，觀看次數將迎來爆發成長。

examples.en: Can you give me a solid book recommendation for learning conversational English?
examples.zh: 你能推薦一本適合用來自主練習道地生活英語口說會話的優質英文書嗎？

examples.en: The doctor's firm recommendation was to get at least eight hours of sleep daily.
examples.zh: 醫生的嚴肅建議是每天至少應保持充足的八小時高品質深度睡眠。

words.definition: 著作權；版權

examples.en: Receiving three copyright strikes will result in permanent channel termination.
examples.zh: 若頻道累計遭到權利人提出三次版權警告（Strike），將會面臨被官方永久停權封號。

examples.en: The author holds exclusive copyright over all text and illustrations in the novel.
examples.zh: 作者擁有該部小說中所有文字篇章與精美手繪插畫的獨家著作權保護。

examples.en: Never use background tracks without permission, or your video may face copyright claims.
examples.zh: 未經授權切勿擅自使用受版權保護的背景配樂，否則影片可能會面臨版權索賠。

words.definition: 免版稅的；無版權限制公播的

examples.en: Always use licensed royalty-free music in monetized commercial video projects.
examples.zh: 在所有涉及商業營利變現的影片專案中，請務必使用合法授權的免版稅公播音樂。

examples.en: She sourced high-resolution royalty-free photos from a stock photography library.
examples.zh: 她從專業圖庫網站中下載了多張高解析度免版稅商用圖檔作為設計素材。

examples.en: Paying once for royalty-free audio tracks lets you use them in multiple video productions.
examples.zh: 購買一次免版稅音效音軌授權，就能讓你在後續多支影片製作中重複安心使用。

words.definition: 錄音室；攝影棚；工作室

examples.en: The creator converted an extra bedroom into a fully soundproof recording studio.
examples.zh: 該創作者將家中多餘的客房改建為鋪滿專業吸音棉的專業隔音錄音室工作室。

examples.en: The film studio announced that production on the superhero sequel will begin next month.
examples.zh: 該大型電影製片廠宣布，這部超級英雄系列續集的實地拍攝作業將於下個月正式啟動。

examples.en: He rents a compact sunny studio apartment located near the central subway station.
examples.zh: 他在市中心捷運站旁租了一間小巧精緻、採光極佳的單間獨立套房。

words.definition: 多機位的；多鏡頭切換的

examples.en: Multi-camera setups allow seamless switching between close-ups and wide shots.
examples.zh: 多機位拍攝配置能讓導播在主持人大特寫與全景鏡頭之間行雲流水般即時無縫切換。

examples.en: The television talk show relies on a multi-camera production system to capture reactions.
examples.zh: 這檔電視談話性娛樂節目仰賴多機位攝影系統，即時捕捉每位來賓細微的面部反應。

examples.en: Setting up a multi-camera live broadcast requires careful cable management and video switchers.
examples.zh: 架設多鏡頭多機位的現場即時直播，需要井然有序的線路整理與多訊號導播切換器。

words.definition: 影片解析度；決心；解決

examples.en: Export the master file in 4K resolution at sixty frames per second.
examples.zh: 請以 4K 超高解析度並搭配每秒六十幀（60 FPS）的極致流暢規格匯出母帶檔案。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times a week is a common goal.
examples.zh: 下定新年新希望並立志每週至少規律運動三次，是許多人最常見的新年決心。

examples.en: The United Nations General Assembly passed a historic resolution calling for peace.
examples.zh: 聯合國大會以壓倒性多數正式通過了一項呼籲和平與停止衝突的歷史性決議案。

words.definition: 傳輸位元率；碼率

examples.en: Set an optimal video bitrate to ensure silky-smooth livestream playback.
examples.zh: 設定適當且充足的影像傳輸位元率（Bitrate）以確保直播畫面流暢無卡頓與馬賽克。

examples.en: A higher audio bitrate results in clearer sound but consumes significantly more bandwidth.
examples.zh: 較高的音訊位元率能帶來更細膩豐富的高音質，但同時也會耗費更多傳輸頻寬。

examples.en: If your video looks pixelated during action scenes, try increasing the recording bitrate.
examples.zh: 如果你的影片在快速移動動作場景時出現模糊馬賽克，請嘗試拉高錄製的編碼位元率。

words.definition: 影片緩衝中；暫存載入

examples.en: Fast optical broadband eliminates annoying video buffering circles completely.
examples.zh: 申辦極速光纖寬頻網路能徹底告別在線上追劇看片時惱人轉圈圈的影片緩衝等待。

examples.en: The stream stopped momentarily due to constant buffering caused by poor Wi-Fi reception.
examples.zh: 由於 Wi-Fi 訊號微弱接收不良導致頻繁緩衝載入，網路直播畫面一度中斷停擺。

examples.en: Lower the video streaming quality to 720p if you experience excessive buffering.
examples.zh: 若在播放過程中遇到嚴重頻繁的緩衝延遲轉圈，建議將影片畫質調降至 720p。

words.definition: 音訊母帶後期處理；精通

examples.en: Professional audio mastering balances volume levels across all podcast platforms.
examples.zh: 專業的音訊母帶後期處理能精準平衡音量響度，確保在各大耳機上皆有最佳聆聽體驗。

examples.en: Mastering a foreign language requires consistent daily practice and cultural immersion.
examples.zh: 精通掌握一門外語需要持之以恆的每日練習與深度的文化沉浸。

examples.en: The album is currently in the final mastering stage and will be released next Friday.
examples.zh: 這張全新概念音樂專輯目前已進入最後的母帶後期製作工序，預計下週五正式發行。

words.definition: 同步化；對齊校正 (Sync)

examples.en: Accurate subtitle syncing ensures captions match the speaker's vocal timing.
examples.zh: 精準無誤的字幕同步對齊工法能確保中文字幕與講者的語音發音節奏毫無秒差完全吻合。

examples.en: Cloud syncing keeps all your notes and documents up to date across all devices.
examples.zh: 雲端資料同步功能可確保你在手機與電腦等所有個人裝置上的筆記與文件始終保持最新狀態。

examples.en: He spent hours syncing the multi-camera footage before starting the video edit.
examples.zh: 他在正式開始剪輯影片之前，花了數個小時校準並對齊各個不同機位的拍攝素材。

words.definition: 利基市場；小眾特定的；合適的定位

examples.en: Dominating a passionate niche audience is better than pleasing everyone mildly.
examples.zh: 牢牢深耕並主導一個充滿熱情忠誠度的小眾利基族群，遠勝過面面俱到卻平庸無奇。

examples.en: The boutique café found its profitable niche by serving artisanal single-origin pour-overs.
examples.zh: 這家質感精品咖啡館主打職人手沖單一產區精品豆，成功開闢出利基市場。

examples.en: After experimenting with various careers, she finally found her niche in educational software.
examples.zh: 在嘗試過各行各業之後，她終於在教育科技軟體研發領域找到了最適合發揮的定位。

words.definition: 粉絲社群；社群平台；社區

examples.en: Fostering an active Discord community strengthens bonds between creator and fans.
examples.zh: 悉心經營充滿活力的官方 Discord 專屬社群能極大拉近創作者與廣大粉絲的情感連結。

examples.en: The local community center organizes weekend workshops and sports events for residents.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心每逢週末皆會為附近居民策劃豐富的專題手作工作坊與運動球賽。

examples.en: Online gaming communities provide a supportive space where players can make lasting friendships.
examples.zh: 線上遊戲玩家社群為各國玩家提供了一個溫暖互助的避風港，讓大家結交長久摯友。

words.definition: 虛擬實況主；虛擬偶像 (Virtual YouTuber)

examples.en: Motion-tracked anime avatars bring virtual YouTubers (VTubers) vividly alive.
examples.zh: 透過先進的面部與動態捕捉技術，二次元動漫造型的虛擬實況主（VTuber）活靈活現。

examples.en: That popular VTuber celebrated reaching one million subscribers during a five-hour live concert.
examples.zh: 該知名人氣 VTuber 在長達五小時的個人虛擬線上演唱會中慶祝頻道突破百萬訂閱大關。

examples.en: VTubers combine expressive voice acting with real-time facial capture technology.
examples.zh: 虛擬實況主巧妙結合了生動多變的聲優配音演出與即時精準的面部表情捕捉科技。

words.definition: 網紅；意見領袖 (KOL)；具影響力者

examples.en: Beauty brands collaborate with micro-influencers for authentic cosmetic reviews.
examples.zh: 知名美妝保養品牌積極攜手小資美妝奈米網紅（KOL），進行真實親民的口碑心得推廣。

examples.en: The fitness influencer shares healthy recipes and daily home workout routines with millions.
examples.zh: 這位健身網紅天天與數百萬追蹤者分享減脂營養輕食食譜與居家核心燃脂訓練動作。

examples.en: Influencers must disclose sponsored partnerships transparently according to advertising regulations.
examples.zh: 依據現行網路廣告透明化法規，各領域網紅在發布商業業配合作時必須主動標註。

words.definition: 創作自由；無拘無束的藝術表達

examples.en: Independent podcasting grants full creative freedom without corporate interference.
examples.zh: 獨立自主製作播客節目賦予了創作者全然無拘無束、不受商業贊助干預的極致創作自由。

examples.en: The director chose an indie studio because it offered complete creative freedom over the script.
examples.zh: 這位鬼才導演選擇加盟獨立製片廠，是因為對方願意賦予他對電影劇本百分之百的創作自由。

examples.en: Having the creative freedom to explore innovative ideas makes the project deeply rewarding.
examples.zh: 能夠享有毫無束縛的創作自由去探索創新大膽的點子，讓整個專案過程充滿滿滿成就感。
